clusterElements.name: contextualQueryAugmenter
clusterElements.description:
Augments the user query with contextual data from the content of the provided
documents.

properties.description: When on, the query goes to the model even if no documents were retrieved, so an agent can still answer with its tools. Turn it off for document Q&A: an empty retrieval then sends the Empty Context Prompt Template instead of the query.
properties.label: Allow Empty Context
properties.name: allowEmptyContext

properties.description: The prompt that combines the retrieved documents with the query. It must contain the {context} and {query} placeholders. When empty and Allow Empty Context is on, the context is treated as supplementary and the model may also use its tools and general knowledge. When empty and Allow Empty Context is off, the model answers only from the context and says it does not know otherwise.
properties.label: Prompt Template
properties.name: promptTemplate

properties.description: The prompt sent instead of the query when no documents were retrieved and Allow Empty Context is off. When empty, the model is told the query is outside its knowledge base and to say so politely.
properties.label: Empty Context Prompt Template
properties.name: emptyContextPromptTemplate
